description: This file defines a class ConstantTest that extends Twig's TestExpression. It implements a test to check if a variable's value is identical to a specific PHP constant, with compile logic for rendering this check in PHP code.

classes.name: ConstantTest
classes.description: A class to test if a variable's value is identical to a specified PHP constant within Twig template engine.
